title: SocialAI 0.1: Towards a Benchmark to Stimulate Research on Socio-Cognitive Abilities in Deep Reinforcement Learning Agents
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing and testing socio-cognitive abilities in AI agents, such as inferring intent (e.g., identifying a 'lying' guide). This is framed as a technical challenge for the agent to overcome for task completion, rather than an evaluation of moral or ethical reasoning. The work does not engage with topics of religion, faith, or ethics.
